content:
Yesterday Apple released the second developer beta of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate, and the company is now also rolling out the public beta. Here are the details.

macOS 27.2 public beta 1 is now available

Last week Apple announced that it would skip the macOS 27.1 testing cycle and go straight to the first developer beta of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate. Yesterday, the company released the second developer beta.

This adjustment appears to be related to the iPhone Duo, which goes on sale on October 23 and will ship with iOS 27.1 preinstalled. It is likely that because iOS 27.1 focuses primarily on features and changes for the new foldable model, Apple decided to skip straight to 27.2 testing for its other operating systems.

As for what is currently in the macOS 27.2 beta, the most noteworthy addition is the expansion of languages supported by Siri AI, which is the goal Apple previously promised to achieve in October. As of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate beta 2, Siri AI now supports French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Spanish in addition to English.

macOS 27.2 public beta 1 carries build number 26B5091g, the same as the second developer beta.

If you want to join Apple's free public beta program, please visit beta.apple.com.
